extracted.summary: A solicitor administering a £1.728m Guildford estate, largely the deceased's home, enquires about borrowing £59,000 for professional fees and inheritance tax due 18 October.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about funding for the estate you are administering in Guildford. We have recorded the amount sought (£59,000), the approximate gross estate value (£1,728,000) and the 18 October tax deadline. To take this further we would need confirmation of the grant position, a breakdown of estate assets and liabilities, details of the property, title and any charges over it, the executors' details and identification, and confirmation of the professional fees to be covered. Once we have received those we will review the enquiry and come back to you.
